name: Bladerunner visualiser
description: A voice skin with a glowing green HUD over animated black and white artwork of Pris from Blade Runner. The clip plays while the assistant speaks, breaking up with static like a failing signal, and what you said and the answer appear beside it in terminal type. Pick Bladerunner visualiser in Voice Satellite > Appearance > Assistant 1 skin or Assistant 2 skin.
author: MozKaboom
